verdict.rationale: Docs confirm centralized library/asset publishing across teams and departments (figma-docs-37, figma-docs-12) and a components guide (figma-docs-72), plus library usage analytics across files (figma-docs-55, figma-docs-75), but there is no explicit documentation in the pack of the update-notification/accept-update workflow when a library source component changes. missing for 10: explicit doc on component update propagation/notification workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation of controlled update behavior.
